facts.value: Cian Hogan chose Design and Manufacture Engineering for a mix of technical drawing and problem-solving skills. Practical knowledge of current practices and equipment used in the manufacturing industry was gained, including CAD software SolidWorks, electrical and pneumatic systems, and 3D printing methods.
Cian Hogan completed an 8-month Co-op Placement at Modular Automation, contributed to innovative design in industry, and gained a Mechanical Design Engineer position after graduation.

Lisa Daly chose Design and Manufacture Engineering to learn about product innovation, design considerations, and sustainable manufacturing. Gained project management skills during her Co-op placement with Abbott Diagnostics.
Lisa Daly completed a Co-op placement with Abbott Diagnostics, applying theoretical knowledge from her degree.
